definitions.explanation: The sale of goods in large quantities, typically to retailers or other merchants rather than to end consumers.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{野菜|やさい}の{卸売|おろしうり}をしている。
examples.english: This company does wholesale of vegetables.

examples.japanese: {卸売|おろしうり}{価格|かかく}で{仕入|しい}れる。
{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}で{魚|さかな}を{買|か}う。
examples.english: I buy fish at the wholesale market.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卸売|おろしうり}{業|ぎょう} (wholesale business)
- {卸売|おろしうり}{価格|かかく} (wholesale price)
- {卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう} (wholesale market)
- {卸売|おろしうり}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (wholesaler)

RELATED TERMS:
- {小売|こうり} (retail) - opposite
- {問屋|とんや} (wholesaler)
- {仕入れ|しいれ} (purchasing, stocking)
